title: Go-Bag Inventory Daily Event Volume
dataSources: Go-bag inventories (`gobag:inventory`), prep drills (`prep:drill`), water rotation logs (`water:rotation`), battery expiration checks (`battery:expiration`), and radio tests (`radio:test`).
app: Go-bag inventory audits, household prep drill logs, water rotation schedules, battery expiration trackers, and emergency radio test results streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=gobag:inventory
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(bag_name) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many go-bag inventory events land each day and how many distinct go bag values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest go-bag inventory records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct go bag values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It warns how much go-bag inventory activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
